command:
# G1 (#17): make oracle DB=all on Graviton (Linux aarch64), the canonical oracle platform, for
# both pinned databases (Viral and Standard-8).
# Code: the launch commit (the short sha ending AK2_RUN_ID), cloned from GitHub. Databases: the
# in-region copies declared in AK2_DATASETS (made by `make stage-db DB=viral|standard8` from the
# pinned genome-idx objects, which are in us-east-1 and so cannot be declared here); each SOURCE
# names the genome-idx origin and ETag. Reads: ENA over HTTPS (scripts/fetch-reads.sh, inside
# make oracle). Not a benchmark: no cold rung, no drop_caches. Results are pushed as written.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; B=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}; DATA=${K%/*/*}

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git gcc-c++ make zlib-devel perl jq bzip2 gzip tar findutils > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1
ak2_say "dnf install rc=$? ($(gcc --version | head -1); $(gzip --version | head -1))"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || { ak2_say "ERROR: clone failed"; exit 1; }
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || { ak2_say "ERROR: checkout $SHA failed"; exit 1; }
ak2_say "checkout $SHA head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$W"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
go version > /dev/null || { ak2_say "ERROR: no Go toolchain"; exit 1; }
ak2_say "go: $(go version)"

ak2_phase fetch
for NAME in k2_viral_20260626 k2_standard_08_GB_20260626; do
  P="$DATA/$NAME"; DB="$W/repo/.cache/db/$NAME"
  mkdir -p "$DB"
  ak2_stage "s3://$B/$P/" "$DB/" || { ak2_say "ERROR: stage of $NAME failed"; exit 1; }
  ak2_req ListObjectsV2 1 "$B"
  for f in hash.k2d opts.k2d taxo.k2d SOURCE; do
    # aws s3 cp: one GET below the 8 MiB multipart threshold, else 8 MiB ranged GETs.
    S=$(stat -c%s "$DB/$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    ak2_req GetObject $(( S < 8388608 ? 1 : (S + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$B"
    want=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$P/$f" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)
    ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
    got=$(sha256sum "$DB/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    ak2_say "staged $NAME/$f bytes=$S sha256=$got object-metadata=$want"
    if ! [[ $want =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $got =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || [ "$got" != "$want" ] || ! [ "$S" -gt 0 ]; then
      ak2_say "ERROR: $NAME/$f does not match its sha256 metadata (or is empty)"; exit 1
    fi
  done
  # Only a verified copy is marked as staged.
  echo "staged_from s3://$B/$P/ $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> "$DB/SOURCE"
  ak2_push "$DB/SOURCE" "db-SOURCE-$NAME"
done

ak2_phase build
cd "$W/repo" || exit 1
scripts/oracle-build.sh > "$W/oracle-build.out" 2>&1
ak2_say "oracle-build rc=$? $(tail -1 "$W/oracle-build.out")"
make build > "$W/make-build.out" 2>&1
ak2_say "make build rc=$?"

ak2_phase oracle
make oracle DB=all ORACLE_THREADS=8 > "$W/oracle.out" 2>&1
RC=$?
ak2_say "make oracle DB=all rc=$RC"
tail -5 "$W/oracle.out"

ak2_phase push
for d in results/g1/oracle-*/; do
  for f in "$d"*; do ak2_push "$f" "$(basename "$d")/$(basename "$f")"; done
done
ak2_push "$W/oracle.out" oracle.out
ak2_say "G1 oracle done rc=$RC"
exit $RC
